description: This file defines interfaces and structures related to shape computation graphs in the PyTorch JIT compiler. It includes declarations for registering, retrieving, and linting shape compute graphs associated with function schemas, and a structure representing bounded shape graphs.
external_methods: TORCH_API void RegisterShapeComputeGraphForSchema(const FunctionSchema&, const std::shared_ptr<Graph>&)
TORCH_API void LintShapeComputeGraph(const FunctionSchema*, const std::shared_ptr<Graph>&)

classes.name: BoundedShapeGraphs
classes.description: A structure holding shared pointers to lower and upper bound shape graphs used for shape analysis.

methods.name: RegisterShapeComputeGraphForSchema
methods.description: Registers a shape compute graph for a given function schema.

methods.name: shapeComputeGraphForSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the shape compute graph associated with a function schema, if it exists.

methods.name: boundedGraphsForSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the bounded shape graphs (lower and upper bounds) for a given schema, if available.

methods.name: RegisteredShapeComputeSchemas
methods.description: Returns a list of all schemas that have registered shape compute graphs.

methods.name: LintShapeComputeGraph
methods.description: Performs linting (consistency checks) on a shape compute graph associated with a schema.
